author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Hide and show library entries without deleting game files
summary: Hide distracting entries from the library and use the hidden list to show them again. The game files and saves remain on the device.
heroAlt: Original library-grid illustration showing one card moving into a reversible hidden-items tray

blocks.text: Use an EmuCoreX build with the Hide action in the library. Hiding removes an entry from the visible list. It does not delete the game file, saves or texture pack, and it does not free storage. Use this feature for distracting scan results that you want to keep on the device.

Long-press the game cover or placeholder card and choose Hide. Wait for the list to refresh. Confirm that the intended entry disappeared and nearby games remain visible. Initially, hide entries one at a time, especially when filenames are similar or covers are missing. An entry without a cover is not necessarily an unwanted file.

When at least one scanned item is hidden, the menu offers Show hidden. Open that list and choose Show for one entry, or Show all for the whole list. If every entry is hidden, use the library’s access to hidden items. The game files are still present even when the main list has no visible games.

Close and reopen the library to check that the choice is remembered. Hiding uses the item’s stored path. Moving or renaming a file can give the scanner a different path and create a visible entry. Check the actual location before treating that entry as a duplicate or assuming the original visibility choice was lost.

Choose Show to undo hiding. You do not need to import the game again if its folder remains accessible. If the game is missing from both lists, check folder permissions, scanning and file location. Review visibility separately on another device because its paths may differ. Use file comparisons, rather than hiding, when investigating duplicate files.
